sources.facts: MPC Paper A/H3/449B, section 7.1. Tsang Chiu Ho Building at 160–164 Wellington Street was completed in 1970, has nine floors including ground, and adjoins Wellington Street, Aberdeen Street and Wa On Lane on a sloping site.
The May 2024 cadastral plan names Tsang Chiu Ho Building at the Wellington and Aberdeen Street corner and distinguishes the narrower adjacent buildings.
Trial service returned to Wellington Street on 1 April 2024, with official reopening announced for 8 April.
Hong Kong Tourism Board confirms that the business relocated to Tung Ning Building in Sheung Wan in May 2026.
